s1.syndrome_frame: Cardiac dysfunction with possible infiltrative or obstructive process in the setting of a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
Prolonged P-wave duration and abnormal P wave morphology on ECG
key_facts: Patient is in their 70s
History of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
Treated with 8 courses of chemotherapy 4 years ago
No history of structural heart disease or hypertension
Blood pressure is 96/54 mm Hg
Heart rate is 56 bpm
Serum troponin I is 0.04 ng/mL
NT-proBNP is 3896.83 pg/mL
ECG shows prolonged P-wave duration and abnormal P wave morphology
Transthoracic echocardiogram revealed diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
PET-CT scan showed increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium

shortlist.label: Cardiac lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and evidence of masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram

shortlist.label: Lymphomatous pericarditis
shortlist.why_kept: History of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium on PET-CT scan

shortlist.label: Secondary cardiac tumor
shortlist.why_kept: History of malignancy and evidence of masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram

shortlist.label: Metastatic disease to the heart
shortlist.why_kept: History of malignancy and evidence of increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium on PET-CT scan

shortlist.label: Right atrial myxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Evidence of masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram, although less likely given the patient's history of malignancy

raw.rationale: The patient's history of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, the presence of diffuse medium masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram, and increased metabolic activity on PET-CT scan along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium are highly suggestive of cardiac involvement by lymphoma.

rejected.label: Lymphomatous pericarditis
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of lymphoma, the primary issue appears to be masses within the right atrium rather than pericardial involvement alone.

rejected.label: Secondary cardiac tumor
rejected.why: This term is too broad and does not specifically account for the patient's history of lymphoma or the nature of the masses found in the right atrium.

rejected.label: Metastatic disease to the heart
rejected.why: The patient's history and the nature of the masses are more consistent with a primary cardiac lymphoma rather than metastasis from another site.

rejected.label: Right atrial myxoma
rejected.why: The presence of a history of lymphoma and the characteristics of the masses (diffuse, medium, with increased metabolic activity on PET-CT) are not typical for a myxoma, which is usually a benign, solitary tumor.
